title: Rightsizing / Opportunities
description: Every container recommendation ranked by estimated monthly savings, with current vs recommended requests, confidence, risk flags and modes.

list.name: datasource
list.label: Data source
list.description: Prometheus-compatible data source with the hub's VictoriaMetrics (or Prometheus).

list.name: direction
list.label: Show
list.description: Filter rows by the sign of the estimated savings.

panels.title: Net savings in view
panels.description: Net estimated monthly savings of the rows in the table below (filters and the Show variable apply).

targets.expr: sum(sum by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload, container) (max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload, container, resource) (ro_recommendation_monthly_savings_usd{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", workload=~"$workload", container=~"$container"})) $direction)

panels.title: Containers in view
panels.description: Number of container rows in the table below.

targets.expr: count(sum by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload, container) (max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload, container, resource) (ro_recommendation_monthly_savings_usd{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", workload=~"$workload", container=~"$container"})) $direction)

panels.title: Decreases
panels.description: Containers whose recommendation lowers cost (positive savings).

targets.expr: count(sum by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload, container) (max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload, container, resource) (ro_recommendation_monthly_savings_usd{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", workload=~"$workload", container=~"$container"})) > 0)

panels.title: Increases
panels.description: Containers whose recommendation raises cost (negative savings): usually throttled or OOM-killed.

targets.expr: count(sum by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload, container) (max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload, container, resource) (ro_recommendation_monthly_savings_usd{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", workload=~"$workload", container=~"$container"})) < 0)

panels.title: Opportunities by monthly savings
panels.description: One row per container with a recommendation, ranked by estimated monthly savings (negative = the recommendation raises the request). Requests are per pod; savings include the average replica count. Click a workload to open its drill-down. Columns are filterable; Mode/Phase come from agent reports.

targets.expr:
(sum by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload, container) (max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload, container, resource) (ro_recommendation_monthly_savings_usd{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", workload=~"$workload", container=~"$container"})))
and on (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload, container) (sum by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload, container) (max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload, container, resource) (ro_recommendation_monthly_savings_usd{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", workload=~"$workload", container=~"$container"})) $direction)

(max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload, container) (ro_recommendation_cpu_cores{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", workload=~"$workload", container=~"$container", type="request", source="current"}))
and on (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload, container) (sum by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload, container) (max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload, container, resource) (ro_recommendation_monthly_savings_usd{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", workload=~"$workload", container=~"$container"})) $direction)

(max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload, container) (ro_recommendation_cpu_cores{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", workload=~"$workload", container=~"$container", type="request", source="recommended"}))
and on (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload, container) (sum by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload, container) (max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload, container, resource) (ro_recommendation_monthly_savings_usd{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", workload=~"$workload", container=~"$container"})) $direction)

(max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload, container) (ro_recommendation_memory_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", workload=~"$workload", container=~"$container", type="request", source="current"}))
and on (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload, container) (sum by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload, container) (max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload, container, resource) (ro_recommendation_monthly_savings_usd{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", workload=~"$workload", container=~"$container"})) $direction)

(max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload, container) (ro_recommendation_memory_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", workload=~"$workload", container=~"$container", type="request", source="recommended"}))
and on (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload, container) (sum by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload, container) (max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload, container, resource) (ro_recommendation_monthly_savings_usd{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", workload=~"$workload", container=~"$container"})) $direction)

((max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload) (ro_recommendation_confidence{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", workload=~"$workload"}))
+ on (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload) group_right ()
(0 * group by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload, container) (ro_recommendation_cpu_cores{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", workload=~"$workload", container=~"$container", source="recommended"} or ro_recommendation_memory_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", workload=~"$workload", container=~"$container", source="recommended"})))
and on (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload, container) (sum by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload, container) (max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload, container, resource) (ro_recommendation_monthly_savings_usd{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", workload=~"$workload", container=~"$container"})) $direction)

(((
  (max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload) (ro_workload_mode{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", workload=~"$workload", resource="cpu", mode="auto-patch"}) == 1) * 2
  or (max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload) (ro_workload_mode{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", workload=~"$workload", resource="cpu", mode="audit"}) == 1) * 1
  or (max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload) (ro_workload_mode{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", workload=~"$workload", resource="cpu", mode="off"}) == 1) * 0
))
+ on (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload) group_right ()
(0 * group by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload, container) (ro_recommendation_cpu_cores{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", workload=~"$workload", container=~"$container", source="recommended"} or ro_recommendation_memory_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", workload=~"$workload", container=~"$container", source="recommended"})))
and on (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload, container) (sum by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload, container) (max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload, container, resource) (ro_recommendation_monthly_savings_usd{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", workload=~"$workload", container=~"$container"})) $direction)

(((
  (max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload) (ro_workload_mode{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", workload=~"$workload", resource="memory", mode="auto-patch"}) == 1) * 2
  or (max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload) (ro_workload_mode{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", workload=~"$workload", resource="memory", mode="audit"}) == 1) * 1

))
+ on (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload) group_right ()

and on (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload, container) (sum by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload, container) (max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload, container, resource) (ro_recommendation_monthly_savings_usd{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", workload=~"$workload", container=~"$container"})) $direction)

(((
  (max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload) (ro_workload_phase{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", workload=~"$workload", phase="Released"}) == 1) * 5

))
+ on (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload) group_right ()
(0 * group by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload, container) (ro_recommendation_cpu_cores{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", workload=~"$workload", container=~"$container", source="recommended"} or ro_recommendation_memory_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", workload=~"$workload", container=~"$container", source="recommended"})))
and on (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload, container) (sum by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload, container) (max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload, container, resource) (ro_recommendation_monthly_savings_usd{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", workload=~"$workload", container=~"$container"})) $direction)

* on (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload) group_left (f_restarting)

))

panels.title: Top 10 workloads
panels.description: Workloads with the highest net estimated monthly savings (all containers).

targets.expr: sort_desc(topk(10, sum by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload) (max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload, container, resource) (ro_recommendation_monthly_savings_usd{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", workload=~"$workload", container=~"$container"}))))

panels.title: Largest increases
panels.description: Workloads whose recommendations raise cost the most: under-provisioned today.

targets.expr: sort(bottomk(10, sum by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload) (max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload, container, resource) (ro_recommendation_monthly_savings_usd{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", workload=~"$workload", container=~"$container"})) < 0))
